name: career
description: Route a job-search request to the right DSH career skill. Use when the user pastes a job description, asks whether a role fits, wants a CV or cover letter tailored, or needs interview preparation. Loads job-fit, resume-tailor, or interview-prep.

name: interview-prep
description: Prepare for a specific job interview. Research the company and role, build a STAR+R story bank from the user's real experience, map likely questions to stories, draft questions to ask, and produce a time-blocked plan. Use when the user has an interview scheduled or asks for interview prep.

name: job-fit
description: Evaluate a job description against the user's CV and decide whether it is worth applying to. Scores fit 1-5, checks liveness and hard dealbreakers, maps must-have requirements to evidence, estimates compensation, and flags posting risks. Use when the user pastes a job or asks "should I apply", "is this a fit", or "score this role".

name: resume-tailor
description: Tailor a CV, resume, or cover letter to a specific job description without inventing anything. Extracts the JD's requirements, maps them to real evidence, rewrites the summary and bullets for ATS and the recruiter's six-second scan, and marks missing facts. Use when the user wants a tailored CV, cover letter, or application answers.
